opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Our grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government, ordinarily resident in Scotland (or with a substantial recent connection), entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK (or with Limited Leave to Remain valid for the course, or an asylum seeker), and enrolled on or holding an unconditional offer for an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish institution. Not eligible for public funds towards tuition fees. Second-degree applicants considered in limited skills-shortage subject areas.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate students at eligible Scottish higher education institutions who come from low-income households and are not eligible for government tuition fee funding. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis for academic year 2026-27.
